newsitem.title: USA: NumereX to pay $1 mln in settlement.
newsitem.headline: NumereX to pay $1 mln in settlement.

text.p: NumereX Corp said on Friday it will take a $1 million charge against its earnings for the fiscal year ended October 31, 1996, for the settlement of securities litigation.
NumereX said the litigation was pending in the U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals for the third circuit.
Settlement of the case is subject to court approval, the company said.

Numerex makes and markets a channel system that enables the transmission of data over existing telephone lines to perform alarm reporting and other functions without interfering with voice communications.
